== Players Committee forum (forum.starwarsccg.org) facts added, 24 November 2026 ==
New page from the live Players Committee forum. Title chosen as "July 2008 Minnesota Mini-Open" (proposed "2008 Minnesota Mini-Open (July)") so that it does not collide with the separate Minnesota Mini-Open of 27 September 2008, which is an unlinked row in [[List of SWCCG tournaments]]. Sources used: topics 21613 (posts 311565, 318126, 318197), 22883 (post 332133).
=== Possibly faulty data ===
* Third place is posted as "North Dakota States champ Tom Rollfinger". No player of that name appears elsewhere; the 2008 North Dakota States bye went to [[Tom Frafjord]] (auto-bid list, 22883/332133), so it may be a joke name for Frafjord, but it is left as written.
=== Left out ===
* Raveling's jokes ("approximately 156 people"); Jacobson's website link (not archived); the Toys R Us midnight release.
